name: Blog
looksLike: a site with posts about one topic
a personal website with dated articles
a writer sharing stories and updates
definition: A site built around posts, usually organized by topic and publication date, where a person or team shares ideas, stories, tutorials, or updates.
goal: Help readers discover and read useful posts.
audience: Readers interested in a writer or subject

sections.name: Introduction and topics
sections.purpose: Explain the subject and help readers choose a topic.

sections.name: Post index
sections.purpose: Show titles, summaries, authors, and publication dates.

sections.name: Article
sections.purpose: Present a readable story with clear structure and attribution.

sections.name: Continue reading
sections.purpose: Suggest relevant posts and an optional subscription.

avoid: Subscription prompts that hide the article

prompts.short: Build a blog with topic navigation, a post index, readable articles, and related posts.
prompts.detailed: Build a blog website for readers interested in a writer or subject. Help readers discover and read useful posts. Include introduction and topics, post index, article, continue reading. Use responsive layouts, clear labels, keyboard access, and visible focus. Readable text and descriptive headings.
